description: One page of recent swaps where `mint` is either swap leg (REST history, not a live tail). Includes token↔token rows when present. Quote assets (SOL, USDC, USDT) are rejected as `mint` (use get_token_metadata / get_token_price for those). Filter venues with `source` (one) or `sources` (array), not both. `minVolumeUsd` / `maxVolumeUsd` bound the USD size (rows with no USD value are then excluded). `solOnly: true` keeps only SOL-paired rows. Each side carries `symbol` (null until resolved; key on mint); a routed swap is one row per hop with the same signature. To page, pass `cursor` = previous `next`; stop when `next` is null. Prefer limit ≤ 20 (default) to conserve context.

cursor.description: Pass the previous response's `next` for the next page

from.description: Unix ms or ISO-8601 start bound

limit.description: Rows per page; default 20 to conserve context — raise only if needed

solOnly.description: When true, keep only swaps with wrapped SOL on the other leg

source.description: Single source, e.g. "pump_fun". Use `sources` for several.

sources.description: Several sources, e.g. ["pump_fun", "pump_amm"] (OR). Do not combine with `source`.

to.description: Unix ms or ISO-8601 end bound

name: list_token_trades
